content.short: A Bootcamp program geared toward teaching novice programmers the fundamentals of Haskell needed to successfully learn Plutus.
content.description:
Learning Plutus as a first language is nearly impossible without first learning the fundamentals of Haskell. Zero to Haskell is a bootcamp that was designed by a Plutus Pioneer graduate who actually learned Haskell as his first programming language. This program is uniquely designed to teach novice programmers the fundamentals of Haskell in order to get our students accepted into the Plutus Pioneer Program and successfully learn Plutus.

Our goal is to bring more developers into the Cardano ecosystem. We are the launchpad for novices to get a career in Cardano.
